experiment: E118 qwen_comparator_table (plan reports/plans/2026-11-06_plan_e118-qwen-comparator-table.md). Filed 2026-11-06 before any run; never edited after it.
kind: A join, not a verdict: only the controls are filed. Every comparator cell is E92's or E102's reading, unchanged code and settings, on a state another lead saved; build.py sets it beside the VPD rows with no rule.

settings.quantile_rows_source: E102's corpus sample for the engaged values: FineWeb rows window_rows to window_rows + quantile_rows of qwen_carrying/results/large/fineweb_rows.safetensors (run.py corpus); read here for the gold rows only, a1 and TOFU engaged values are E102's file, the real rows' E103's
settings.draw_seed_rule: a state's draws use torch.Generator seed 102 + 1 + its index in run.py CARRY (E102's score.py rule, seed + 1 + read index); the a1_s0 control uses index 2, E102's own index for a1_s0, so its draws are E102's
settings.budget_s_source: E102's budget_s: the debug QoS 30-min rule less 3 min

C0_zero.rule: First and alone in each part. E92's do-nothing file (qwen_anchor1/results/large/dW/a1/step_1.safetensors, E91's anchor1_s0 step 1) read as a state. Comparators: total norm exactly 0, max |state log P - W0 log P| on anchor 1's rows <= zero_logp_max, steering layer None. Carrying: on anchor 1's first 16 rows, max |T1 - T0| <= zero_logp_max, |nums[N]| <= zero_logp_max, carrying set empty. A miss stops the job.
C0_zero.source: E92's zero_logp_max and E102's E0_max (both 1e-5); E92 read 0 (qwen_comparators/results/controls.json zero), E102 read 0.0, 0.0, set 0 (qwen_carrying/results/w0.json checks.E0_do_nothing)
C0_zero.expected: every number exactly 0, steering None, set size 0

C1_e92.rule: Comparators part, after C0. W0's mean log P (all) on anchor 1's, TOFU's and the gold rows within rel of E92's results/W0_{a1,tofu,gold}.json; then anchor 1 seed 0 step 100 (qwen_anchor1/results/large/dW/a1/step_100.safetensors) through qwen_comparators.read_state against E92's results/states/anchor1_s0_step100.json: total norm within norm_rel; gain.all.gain within rel; steering layer equal; steering.steer.all.share and steering.random.all.share each within E92's stored share_se of the stored share. Relative = |x - ref| / |ref|. A miss stops the job.
C1_e92.norm_rel_source: E92's e91_norm_rel: the same file summed in fp64
C1_e92.rel_source: E102's E1_rel, the tolerance E102 used to reproduce E92's W0 log P and gains; E102 read them to 0 and 8.5e-8 relative (qwen_carrying/results/run.log lines 4, 5, 23)
C1_e92.share_band_source: E92's stated noise floor: the share's row standard error (predictions.json noise_floor), stored per state
C1_e92.expected: every number as stored to the last digits or near it (same card type, code and batch); the bands are E92's noise, far wider

C2_e102.rule: Carrying part, after C0. Anchor 1 seed 0 step 100 through qwen_neurons.state_cells on anchor 1's rows against E102's results/states/a1_s0.json: gain within rel; nums[172032] (every neuron patched) within rel; the top-1024 carrying set shares at least min_set_overlap with E102's. A miss stops the job. Its prompt overlap and engaged share (E102's draws seed) are logged beside E102's score.json per_state.a1_s0, unscored.
C2_e102.rel_source: E102's E1_rel (its stated tolerance for a re-read)
C2_e102.min_set_overlap_source: E103's C2 and E105's C2n, the filed tolerance for re-reading a stored carrying set (known_answer_pair/results/predictions_amend1.json neurons.C2); read 1.0 on this path four times (jobs 53209, 53275, 53334, 53480)
C2_e102.expected: gain and nums as stored to about 1e-7 relative, set overlap 1.0

controls.edge_cases_run: C0 on a zero change: relative tolerances are not used there (absolute bands), so no zero denominator; every C1 and C2 reference is non-zero (targets above). A missing stored file stops with the name before the model loads. The steering share band is the stored se, never 0 (0.0189 and 0.0066).
controls.do_nothing_against_the_bar: C0 is the do-nothing reading itself; it cannot pass C1 or C2, whose targets are a learned state's non-zero numbers.

not_filed: No rule on any comparator or on its relation to a VPD reading: the table is read by the write-up (decisions.md, baseline retarget, 2026-11-06, step 3).
